inputs.model.prompt:
Create ONE strict top-down ORTHOGRAPHIC floor plan of the living room shown in the
two reference images: camera exactly vertical above the room, ceiling removed,
no perspective, no visible wall faces, no tilt. Walls drawn as thick dark outlines
seen from above. No people, no animals, no text, labels, numbers, dimensions,
arrows, compass or legend.

REFERENCE IMAGE 1 is a wide view of this room taken from the entrance; REFERENCE
IMAGE 2 is a closer view of the same room. Both show the SAME room: reproduce
exactly their furniture, proportions and positions, seen from above. Orientation
of the plan: the window wall at the TOP, the entrance side (where the camera stood)
at the BOTTOM, the TV wall on the RIGHT, the sofa side on the LEFT.

Place, as in the references: the large floor-to-ceiling window with curtains centred
on the TOP wall; the entrance door at the BOTTOM-LEFT corner, opening inward; the dark
grey L-shaped sofa on the LEFT half: one long section running from bottom to top
along the left side with its seat facing RIGHT toward the TV, joined at the top-left
corner to a section running along the top toward the centre with its seat facing
DOWN, cushions and the knitted throw on it; behind the sofa in the TOP-LEFT corner
a small side table with the warm amber lamp and a large potted plant beside it; the
rectangular wooden coffee table in the CENTRE, in front of the sofa's corner, with a
dark mug, a small bowl, a remote and a few books, on a dark patterned rectangular rug;
on the RIGHT wall a long low wooden TV cabinet with the flat TV facing LEFT toward the
sofa, a small plant at its lower end; a tall bookshelf against the right wall near the
TOP-RIGHT corner with a small plant at its foot; warm wooden parquet everywhere.
Same furniture count and scale as the references; nothing added.

Painted illustration in the same graphic language as the references: fine visible
contours, flat painted tones, dark grey sofa, warm wood, dark rug, soft even light
so every piece is legible; small warm glow at the lamp, the TV seen from above as a
thin dark rectangle with a faint cool-green edge. Room centred in a 16:9 frame.
